Outer space and stars

太空与星星

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Have you ever learned about outer space and stars?

Yeah, I have, actually. We covered a bit in school, you know, basic stuff about planets and the solar system, and I've also picked up a lot from sci-fi movies like Iron Man, which got me curious about space.

学校学过星球和太阳系的基础知识，也从钢铁侠这类科幻片里了解到不少。

Q2Do you like science fiction movies? Why?

Yeah, I really do. I mean, films like Iron Man take you to worlds you'll never see in real life, and the futuristic technology is just fascinating to watch. Plus, they always make me wonder what space is actually like.

喜欢科幻片，钢铁侠展示的未来科技很迷人，还让人好奇太空真实的样子。

Q3Do you want to know more about outer space?

Oh, definitely. I'd love to learn more about things like black holes and space travel, you know, just to satisfy my curiosity. The thing is, there's still so much we don't know, and that's what excites me.

想了解更多太空知识，比如黑洞和太空旅行，未知的东西最吸引我。

Q4Do you want to go into outer space in the future?

Hmm, honestly, no, I don't. I find space fascinating from a distance, but actually going there sounds terrifying, since it's dangerous and so far from home. I'd rather just keep learning about it here on Earth.

不想亲自去太空，觉得太危险、离家太远，更愿意在地球上学习太空知识。
